title: Help Out Some Bumbling Penguins With This Week’s Epic Games Store Freebie
summary: The Epic Games Store continues to give away a free game each week, and this week's offering is another nice find at a price that can't be beat. Every Thursday at 8 AM PT / 11 AM ET, Epic offers at least one free PC game (and sometimes even as many as two or three). All you need to do to claim the free games is create a free Epic account and enable two-factor authentication. You have a week to add the freebies to your library before the new one(s) take their place. At this point, Epic has given away hundreds of free games, and there's no sign that the program will stop any time soon. The company has also extended its freebies to Android devices, and you can claim a free game every week here as well . We keep this article up to date weekly to highlight both the current free games and next week's offerings. If you're looking for more freebies, you can check out our list of the 25 best free PC games to play right now , or for more options, the 25 best free games to play on multiple platforms. Current free games at Epic Bread and Fred This week, you can get a welcome gift pack for Firestone: Idle Clicker Online RPG, and you can help a pair of penguins out in the co-op platformer Bread & Fred . The welcome pack for Firestone is valued at $100, and it includes an exclusive Talia skin, chests, avatars and gems. New players must reach stage 15 to claim it. Next free game at Epic Next week, you can get Strange Antiquities for free. Run a shop full of occult antiques in the eerie town of Undermere, uncover sinister secrets, help the locals out, and do pet your adorable shop cat. See all free games at Epic Epic Games Store free games list We're keeping a running list of every free game that Epic users have been able to claim in the past. From AAA hits to indie darlings, Epic has really made its mark with free games. You can even snag these games if you don't have a powerful PC so you can play them if you ever get one. title: Help Out Some Bumbling Penguins With This Week’s Epic Games Store Freebie
summary: The Epic Games Store continues to give away a free game each week, and this week's offering is another nice find at a price that can't be beat. Every Thursday at 8 AM PT / 11 AM ET, Epic offers at least one free PC game (and sometimes even as many as two or three). All you need to do to claim the free games is create a free Epic account and enable two-factor authentication. You have a week to add the freebies to your library before the new one(s) take their place. At this point, Epic has given away hundreds of free games, and there's no sign that the program will stop any time soon. The company has also extended its freebies to Android devices, and you can claim a free game every week here as well . We keep this article up to date weekly to highlight both the current free games and next week's offerings. If you're looking for more freebies, you can check out our list of the 25 best free PC games to play right now , or for more options, the 25 best free games to play on multiple platforms. The welcome pack for Firestone is valued at $100, and it includes an exclusive Talia skin, chests, avatars and gems. New players must reach stage 15 to claim it. Next free game at Epic Next week, you can get Strange Antiquities for free. Run a shop full of occult antiques in the eerie town of Undermere, uncover sinister secrets, help the locals out, and do pet your adorable shop cat.
